phrases.latin: Quid meum nōmen significat, tata? — Graecum nōmen est, idque dōnum Deī significat. — Ego dōnum sum!
phrases.english: What does my name mean, Dad? — It’s a Greek name, and it means gift of God. — I’m a gift!
phrases.source: Libellus V, Lisbōna: castellum et ōceanārium

phrases.latin: Deō; haec enim omnia dōna ejus sunt.
phrases.english: To God; for all these things are his gifts.

sources: Lewis & Short: donum
